title: Arak Son of Thunder #2 DC 1981 Roy Thomas Ernie Colon The Devil Takes a Bride
conditionDescription: Bright cover, light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. Small handwritten "C-695" at the lower left of the front cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Arak, Son of Thunder #2 (October 1981), DC Comics - "The Devil Takes a Bride." A full-length blockbuster by Roy Thomas and Ernie Colon. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: Tyco Magnum 440 HO racing cars ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. Small handwritten "C-695" at the lower left of the front cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
